pattern_families.label: Standard 7-column genealogy table with separate summary row
pattern_families.description: Genealogy tables with headers NAME, BORN, MARRIED, SPOUSE, BOY, GIRL, DIED, followed by a separate summary/total descendants table. Subgroup/context rows are present but not concatenated. No fused BOYGIRL headers. No left-column-only family rows. Notes are not present in the DIED column.
allowed_variants: summary/total table may be present after main table

document_local_conventions.subgroup_context_rows: Single, non-concatenated subgroup/context rows are allowed.
document_local_conventions.table_fragmentation: One genealogy table per chapter, plus a separate summary/total table is allowed.
document_local_conventions.summary_rows: Summary/total descendants table is allowed and expected.
document_local_conventions.marginal_or_handwritten_notes: No marginal or handwritten notes present; if present, should not be in DIED column.

pattern_families.label: Standard 7-column genealogy table with minor fragmentation or context drift
pattern_families.description: Chapters that mostly follow the standard 7-column pattern but show minor fragmentation (multiple genealogy tables per chapter) or concatenated subgroup/context rows.

document_local_conventions.subgroup_context_rows: Should not be concatenated; each context row should be separate.
document_local_conventions.table_fragmentation: Prefer one genealogy table per chapter, but minor fragmentation is observed.
document_local_conventions.marginal_or_handwritten_notes: No marginal or handwritten notes present.

pattern_families.description: Standard 7-column genealogy table, but with a child note or annotation incorrectly placed in the DIED column.
allowed_variants: None; this is a semantic error, not a legitimate variant.
